sourceContactRepair.outsideFigureMethod: Native SVG feComponentTransfer RGB tableValues='1 0' in a second luminance mask; nested group masks source-contact image with inverse figure occupancy. No PNG is edited.
sourceContactRepair.role: Room-fixed original source contact pixels at hip/palm and the adjoining floor around both shoes. This restores source surface RGB rather than drawing one flat shadow color across different materials.
sourceContactRepair.fixedTo: shared original room stage; never inside actor translation
removeOn: theme or original mother SHA changes
mother, background or either mask is not loaded or fails
sourceContactRepair.runtimeSupport: Original-mother RGB contact-mask layer plus inverse-figure masking must be supported by the runtime owner before registration. The existing flat-color luminance shadow mode alone does not reproduce this candidate.
sourceContactRepair.observedBoundary: Raw contact mask is not a transferable generic shadow. It includes a narrow source contact surround; native inverse figure occupancy removes source figure coverage. It must never remain alone when the figure is hidden.

observations: Old detached rear-head white debris is removed from the offered person mask.
Figure-mask-v1 still selected a naturally white pillow corner through the right hair loop; figure-mask-v2 removes that island and keeps the surrounding fine source hair.
Original youthful face, smile, chest-hand gesture, supporting palm, skirt, knees, socks and both complete loafers retain mother RGB and original placement.
Native original-RGB contact restoration avoids the gray floor halo and warm cushion stain produced by the rejected flat-color shadow calibrations.
The reused empty background keeps the same room furniture and camera; it is an inpainted reconstruction and is not claimed pixel-identical to every original room surface.
limitations: Static exact-source/zero-offset candidate only; motion, drag, product failure/hide behavior and actual runtime are not verified.
Primary must personally inspect before admission.
Original source-lit fine warm/blue-white hair rims remain. RGB decontamination was not performed; this source is limited to its original apricot lighting.

rejected.reason: Natural checked-pillow white corner retained as a detached bright block inside right hair loop near x1403..1419/y462..473.
At source floor point (1165,788), luminance was only 4/255 while source contact RGB was (168,100,57) versus background (254,209,145); core not restored.
Grayish contact halo on warm floor.
Warm floor improved but original light cushion acquired a brown stain.

review.producerRecommendation: Offer figure-mask-v2 and original-RGB source-contact composition for primary static review.

cleanup.note: No disposable scripts or caches were created. Rejected outputs and fixed observation versions remain as diagnostic provenance.
